research_brief.object: Marine deep-biosphere habitats across aphotic water, sediment/pore water, and oceanic crustal fluids
research_brief.central_claim: A calibrated habitat-resolved hierarchy can estimate volume, cells, composition, and activity without conflating their units.
research_brief.falsification: The stratified model fails to outperform depth-only baselines or conflicts with independent rate/geochemical evidence.

decision_rules: Do not elevate functional potential to realized activity without rate or geochemical support.
Do not integrate abundance beyond a habitat's explicit volume and porosity model.
Do not retain biological signal without blank and contamination lineage.
Report astrobiology only as a bounded Earth-analogue inference.
